column1: # Reviewed function-level semantic ground truth for EqBench Neq samples (Issue #104).
# gate treats "CONFIRMED_NOT_EQ && checker EQUIVALENT" as a hard violation.
# A source change is NOT evidence of non-equivalence: an entry belongs here
# only after a human has confirmed the verdict for that function pair and
# recorded how (the evidence column).  The checker never reads this file.
#   sample     Neq sample identity as the runner names it, e.g. REVE/triangularMod/Neq/newV-oldV
#   evidence   free text: how the verdict was confirmed (counter-example, proof, review note)
